outcome: miRNA expression levels (let-7b-3p, let-7f-1-3p, miR-191-3p, miR-550a-5p, miR-33b-3p, miR-425-3p) in human decidua mesenchymal stromal cells (hDMSCs)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of human decidua mesenchymal stromal cells (hDMSCs) isolated from 7 preeclampsia patients and 7 healthy pregnant women.
finding: Levels of hsa-miR-33b-3p were significantly increased in hDMSCs of preeclampsia patients compared to healthy controls, suggesting its potential as a biomarker for preeclampsia.
cross-section timing: Samples (hDMSCs from decidua) were collected post-delivery from women diagnosed with preeclampsia and healthy pregnant women.
